scope: P0 test data leakage investigation; no destructive cleanup performed

rootCause.conclusion: The three records were written by the manual browser acceptance session against the ordinary Docker PostgreSQL database.
evidence: HAR /tmp/pompom-idea-NBbDHeH5/live.har contains POST requests at 2026-10-11T21:45:56Z, 21:48:46Z and 21:50:12Z matching the database created_at values.
The POST sequence is exactly the Idea, Detailed Story and Existing Production Prompt acceptance flow; no test runner log contains these titles.
Backend integration tests configure PostgreSQLContainer JDBC URLs through DynamicPropertySource, separate from the Docker app at jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/pompom.

isolationChange.sameTargetCheck: PASS: guard refused the ordinary application target with exit 1

cleanup.scope: 3 draft identities, 6 workflow events, content 9, prompt version 9, and only dependent rows shown in the dry-run backup

limitations: The browser acceptance flow is now required to invoke the isolation guard before any mutating request; the prior manual flow was the identified source of leakage.
